processing_method: ashtasamskara (8-fold purification): shodhana with lime juice + garlic + brick powder then mardana
dosha_effect: tridosha-shamaka when properly processed; toxic if impure
contraindications: never use without full shodhana; avoid in pregnancy and weak agni
source_text: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 3.1-20; Rasa Tarangini taranga 5

processing_method: shodhana: melted in ghee + milk then quenched in cow urine
contraindications: skin irritation in excess; avoid with pitta-pradhana constitution
source_text: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 3.60-72; Rasa Tarangini taranga 8

processing_method: shodhana then marana: repeated incineration with herbal juices (aloe vera + lemon) until bhasma
contraindications: avoid in kapha-pradhana obesity; high cost limits availability
source_text: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 5.1-24; Rasa Tarangini taranga 15

processing_method: shodhana in nirgundi svarasa then marana with sulphur
source_text: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 5.25-40; Rasa Tarangini taranga 16

processing_method: shodhana in lemon juice then marana with sulphur and herbal bhavana
contraindications: excess causes vomiting and nausea; avoid in pitta-kopa
source_text: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 5.41-60; Rasa Tarangini taranga 17

processing_method: shodhana: heated and quenched in triphala kashaya 7 times then marana
contraindications: constipation in excess; avoid without anupana of honey or triphala
source_text: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 5.61-82; Rasa Tarangini taranga 20

processing_method: shodhana in nirgundi oil then marana with kanchi (rice water)
contraindications: avoid in high kapha with ama; low potency requires higher dosage
source_text: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 5.83-95; Rasa Tarangini taranga 18

processing_method: shodhana in nirgundi svarasa then repeated marana until nishchandra (lustreless)
contraindications: highly toxic if impure; strictly avoid without complete marana; never in pregnancy
source_text: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 5.96-110; Rasa Tarangini taranga 19

processing_method: shodhana in gomutra then 100+ puta (incineration cycles) with triphala
contraindications: requires satva-patana grade purity; avoid crude/partially processed
source_text: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 2.60-90; Rasa Tarangini taranga 10

processing_method: shodhana in triphala kashaya then marana with aloe vera juice
dosha_effect: pitta-kapha shamaka; best for yakrit-pliha roga (liver-spleen)
contraindications: constipation in sensitive individuals; needs honey as anupana
source_text: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 2.95-110; Rasa Tarangini taranga 21

processing_method: shodhana: ground with lime juice then heated in sealed crucible
contraindications: highly toxic raw; full shodhana mandatory; never internal without expert supervision
source_text: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 2.111-125; Rasa Tarangini taranga 11

processing_method: shodhana: ground with nimbu svarasa then bhavana with gomutra
dosha_effect: kapha-vata shamaka; useful in kushtha (skin disease)
contraindications: toxic raw; strict shodhana required; avoid in pregnancy and pitta-kopa
source_text: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 2.126-140; Rasa Tarangini taranga 11
